recommendation_summary: The reply recommends keeping cron and the script on `edna` and adding one external dead-man's-switch monitor that the wrapped job pings on start, success and failure, with alerts sent by email or phone and tested with a forced crash and a skipped run.
note: The reply sets up one hosted heartbeat alert, says Docker isn't needed, puts off Synology logging until it is needed, and has none of the four labelled record lines.
